name: Pirc Defense
description: A hypermodern Black defense that teaches counterattacking the center rather than occupying it immediately.

branches.title: Main Line: d6 and Nf6
branches.description: Learn the default Pirc setup against e4 and d4.

moves.title: White claims center
moves.explanation: White takes space. e4 changes the central structure. Central pawn moves should either claim space, challenge an enemy pawn, or open a line for a piece. The Pirc lets White build a center, then attacks it with pieces and timely pawn breaks.

moves.title: Prepare counterplay
moves.explanation: d6 controls e5 and keeps Black flexible. d6 changes the central structure. Central pawn moves should either claim space, challenge an enemy pawn, or open a line for a piece. The Pirc lets White build a center, then attacks it with pieces and timely pawn breaks.

moves.title: White expands
moves.explanation: White builds a big pawn center. d4 changes the central structure. Central pawn moves should either claim space, challenge an enemy pawn, or open a line for a piece. The Pirc lets White build a center, then attacks it with pieces and timely pawn breaks.

moves.title: Pressure e4
moves.explanation: Nf6 develops and attacks the e4 pawn from a distance. Nf6 develops a knight to f6. Developed pieces control central squares, help castling, and make future tactics possible without forcing anything too early.

moves.title: Develop to c3
moves.explanation: Nc3 develops a knight to c3. Developed pieces control central squares, help castling, and make future tactics possible without forcing anything too early.

moves.title: Improve with g6
moves.explanation: g6 is a practical improving move for Black. In real games, keep asking: is my king safe, are my pieces active, and what central pawn break comes next?

moves.title: Develop to g7

moves.title: Develop to f3

moves.title: Get the king safe
moves.explanation: O-O moves the king to safety and brings the rook closer to the center. This is usually the moment when the opening becomes an early middlegame plan: The Pirc lets White build a center, then attacks it with pieces and timely pawn breaks.

moves.title: Develop to e3
moves.explanation: Be3 improves a piece and adds control over important squares. Developed pieces create threats naturally, so you do not need to force an attack before castling.

moves.title: Develop to c6

After each move, check king safety, center control, and piece activity.
